Property Tax Info
Collecting Property Tax
Each taxing district within the county must certify a tax levy and special assessments to the Auditor-Treasurer. The Auditor-Treasurer tabulates all of these levies and special assessments and then calculates the amount of real estate, personal, and mobile home tax that will be paid by each property owner in the county based on the valuations certified by the County Assessor and classifications established by the State of Minnesota. In Le Sueur County, the calculation of property taxes is done in conjunction with the Finance Director's Office. Upon completion of the tax, statements are distributed to all taxpayers indicating the amount of tax due and the due date.
Real estate transactions for property located in the county are processed through the Auditor-Treasurer's Office. Le Sueur County has nearly 19,000 parcels.
Collection Process
After each tax deadline, the Auditor-Treasurer's Office must reconcile all collections for accuracy and distribute to each taxing jurisdiction their appropriate share of the taxes collected. State Statutes specify when these payments must be made.
Payment Options
Le Sueur County has several options for paying your property taxes. Property taxes can be paid by cash, check, money order, credit/debit card or by ACH. Select the one that will work best for you. Please note, credit and debit card payments are processed by a third-party processor and a 2.5% convenience fee will apply when the card is ran. This fee is in addition to the tax amount due.
Property Tax Calculator
